variants.name: Классические конусы
variants.prompt:
Use case: game asset concept comparison. The supplied image is the approved stone tile REFERENCE. Create ONE wide, clean, high-resolution comparison image containing exactly TWO complete versions of the same retractable floor spike trap SIDE BY SIDE. LEFT: fully RETRACTED, only flush sockets / small slots visible on the stone surface, NO protruding spikes. RIGHT: fully EXTENDED, all spikes upright emerging from those SAME sockets. The two states MUST have exactly the same design, socket count, distribution, stone texture, scale, lighting, isometric viewpoint and block proportions. Only vertical extension of spikes changes. Keep two clear non-overlapping columns with generous margins and space between the complete blocks, every spike tip and bottom corner visible. No text or labels within the image.
Design 1: Nine separate polished steel conical spikes with circular dark iron sockets, evenly distributed in a staggered 3 by 3 field.
Both blocks preserve the reference blue-grey cracked STONE TOP, the 4:3 diamond projection (native top128x96) and thick brick masonry side faces (native64depth). The upper trapping mechanism occupies the WHOLE top diamond from corner to corner, with enough exposed stone between sockets. This is a built-in RETRACTABLE FLOOR TRAP, not loose caltrops. Mechanism stays inside the top surface, never on the vertical side walls. Medium spike height, clear lethal pointed silhouettes but no giant pillars. Clean compact color groups, polished hand-painted game prop style consistent with the reference, crisp readable edges, NO extra pixelation, no added dither/noise. Whole camera/frame locked and identical between left/right. True transparent alpha outside both isolated blocks. No floor plane, cast shadow outside, background, characters, feet, blood, flames, acid, symbols, floating particles or extra objects. Show ONLY this pair of complete tiles.
